---
title: "methylarray analysis report"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 3
    # Contents on the left, the rest of the page for the report itself; the
    # subsections open for the section being read
    toc-expand: 1
    toc-location: left
    number-sections: true
    number-depth: 3
    toc-title: Contents
    page-layout: full
    theme: cosmo
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <style>
        /* Wide tables scroll inside the text column */
        main.content table { display: block; max-width: 100%; overflow-x: auto; }
        main.content table caption { white-space: normal; }
        /* Every table is a toggle with its bold name; closed until clicked */
        details.report-table { margin: 0.7rem 0; border: 1px solid #dee2e6; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.35rem 0.75rem; }
        details.report-table > summary { cursor: pointer; }
        details.report-table[open] > summary { margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
        /* Figures fill the column up to their natural size */
        main.content img.report-figure { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; }
        /* Long commands wrap instead of running off the page */
        main.content pre, main.content pre code { white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
        /* Search box above the contents */
        .report-search { margin: 0 0 1rem 0; }
        .report-search input { width: 100%; padding: 0.3rem 0.5rem; border: 1px solid #ced4da; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.9rem; }
        .report-search-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.3rem; margin-top: 0.3rem; font-size: 0.8rem; color: #555; }
        .report-search-bar button { border: 1px solid #ced4da; background: #f8f9fa; border-radius: 3px; padding: 0 0.45rem; line-height: 1.4; }
        .report-tables { margin-top: 0.3rem; font-size: 0.8rem; }
        .report-tables button { border: 1px solid #ced4da; background: #f8f9fa; border-radius: 3px; padding: 0 0.45rem; line-height: 1.5; }
        main.content section.level1 > h1 { border-top: 2px solid #dee2e6; padding-top: 1rem; margin-top: 2.5rem; }
        main.content h3 { margin-top: 1.8rem; }
        mark.report-hit { background: #ffe58a; padding: 0; }
        mark.report-hit.report-hit-current { background: #ff9f43; }
        </style>
    include-after-body:
      text: |
        <script>
        // Search the whole report: every match is highlighted, Enter or the arrows
        // jump between matches, and a closed table or tab opens when a match is inside it
        (function () {
          function ready(f) { if (document.readyState !== "loading") f(); else document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", f); }
          ready(function () {
            var main = document.querySelector("main.content") || document.body;
            var toc = document.getElementById("TOC");
            var box = document.createElement("div");
            box.className = "report-search";
            box.innerHTML = '<input type="search" placeholder="Search the report" aria-label="Search the report">' +
              '<div class="report-search-bar"><button type="button" data-step="-1" aria-label="Previous match">&#8593;</button>' +
              '<button type="button" data-step="1" aria-label="Next match">&#8595;</button><span class="report-search-count"></span></div>' +
              '<div class="report-tables"><button type="button" data-open="1">Open all tables</button> <button type="button" data-open="">Close all</button></div>';
            if (toc && toc.parentNode) toc.parentNode.insertBefore(box, toc); else main.insertBefore(box, main.firstChild);
            var input = box.querySelector("input"), count = box.querySelector(".report-search-count");
            var hits = [], current = -1, timer = null;
            function clear() {
              main.querySelectorAll("mark.report-hit").forEach(function (m) {
                var parent = m.parentNode;
                parent.replaceChild(document.createTextNode(m.textContent), m);
                parent.normalize();
              });
              hits = []; current = -1;
            }
            function go(step) {
              if (!hits.length) return;
              if (current >= 0) hits[current].classList.remove("report-hit-current");
              current = (current + step + hits.length) % hits.length;
              var hit = hits[current];
              for (var d = hit.closest("details"); d; d = d.parentElement ? d.parentElement.closest("details") : null) d.open = true;
              for (var pane = hit.closest(".tab-pane"); pane; pane = pane.parentElement ? pane.parentElement.closest(".tab-pane") : null) {
                var tab = document.querySelector('[data-bs-target="#' + pane.id + '"], [href="#' + pane.id + '"][role="tab"]');
                if (tab && !tab.classList.contains("active")) tab.click();
              }
              hit.classList.add("report-hit-current");
              hit.scrollIntoView({ block: "center" });
              count.textContent = (current + 1) + " of " + hits.length;
            }
            function search(term) {
              clear();
              if (term.length < 2) { count.textContent = ""; return; }
              var lower = term.toLowerCase(), nodes = [];
              var walker = document.createTreeWalker(main, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
              while (walker.nextNode()) {
                var node = walker.currentNode;
                if (node.nodeValue.toLowerCase().indexOf(lower) < 0) continue;
                if (node.parentElement.closest("script, style, .report-search")) continue;
                nodes.push(node);
              }
              nodes.forEach(function (node) {
                var text = node.nodeValue, low = text.toLowerCase(), frag = document.createDocumentFragment(), i = 0, j;
                while ((j = low.indexOf(lower, i)) >= 0) {
                  frag.appendChild(document.createTextNode(text.slice(i, j)));
                  var m = document.createElement("mark");
                  m.className = "report-hit";
                  m.textContent = text.slice(j, j + term.length);
                  frag.appendChild(m);
                  hits.push(m);
                  i = j + term.length;
                }
                frag.appendChild(document.createTextNode(text.slice(i)));
                node.parentNode.replaceChild(frag, node);
              });
              count.textContent = hits.length ? hits.length + " matches" : "No matches";
              if (hits.length) go(1);
            }
            input.addEventListener("input", function () { clearTimeout(timer); timer = setTimeout(function () { search(input.value.trim()); }, 250); });
            input.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) { if (e.key === "Enter") { e.preventDefault(); go(e.shiftKey ? -1 : 1); } });
            box.querySelectorAll(".report-tables button").forEach(function (b) { b.addEventListener("click", function () {
              main.querySelectorAll("details.report-table").forEach(function (d) { d.open = b.getAttribute("data-open") === "1"; });
            }); });
            box.querySelectorAll("button[data-step]").forEach(function (b) { b.addEventListener("click", function () { go(parseInt(b.getAttribute("data-step"), 10)); }); });
          });
        })();
        </script>
    fig-width: 8
    fig-height: 4.5
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r setup}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(data.table)
    library(ggplot2)
    library(jsonlite)
    library(knitr)
})
inputs <- "inputs"
find <- function(pattern) sort(list.files(inputs, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE))
has <- function(pattern) length(find(pattern)) > 0
read <- function(file) {
    if (!endsWith(file, ".gz")) return(fread(file, na.strings = c("", "NA")))
    if (file.info(file)[["size"]] < 100) return(fread(text = readLines(gzfile(file)), na.strings = c("", "NA")))
    fread(cmd = paste("gzip -dc", shQuote(file)), na.strings = c("", "NA"))
}
model_of <- function(file, prefix, suffix) sub(paste0("^", prefix), "", sub(paste0(suffix, "$"), "", basename(file)))
# Publication theme: white background, light major grid, readable text
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 11) + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", colour = "grey70"),
                                         legend.key = element_blank(), plot.title.position = "plot"))
options(knitr.kable.NA = "")
params_run <- if (has("^params\\.json$")) fromJSON(find("^params\\.json$")) else list()
param <- function(name) { v <- params_run[[name]]; if (is.null(v)) "" else as.character(v) }
# Headings: a part (level 1, written once, before the first result in it), its
# sections (level 2) and the subsections of a model (level 3)
shown_parts <- character()
part <- function(text) {
    if (!text %in% shown_parts) cat("\n\n#", text, "\n\n")
    shown_parts <<- c(shown_parts, text)
}
heading <- function(text) cat("\n\n##", text, "\n\n")
subheading <- function(text) cat("\n\n###", text, "\n\n")
bullets <- function(lines) cat("\n\n", paste0("- ", lines, "\n"), "\n\n", sep = "")
# Figures side by side as tabs; panels: named list of functions that print one tab each
tabs <- function(panels) {
    if (length(panels) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))
    if (length(panels) == 1) return(invisible(panels[[1]]()))
    cat("\n\n::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")
    for (name in names(panels)) {
        cat("\n\n##### ", name, " {.unnumbered .unlisted}\n\n", sep = "")
        panels[[name]]()
    }
    cat("\n\n:::\n\n")
}
big <- function(n) format(n, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE)
model_id <- function(model) paste0("model-", gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "-", tolower(model)))
# Clock codes of dnaMethyAge with the names they are known by
clock_names <- c(HorvathS2013 = "Horvath 2013", HannumG2013 = "Hannum 2013", LevineM2018 = "PhenoAge", HorvathS2018 = "Skin and blood 2018", ZhangQ2019 = "Zhang Q 2019",
                 LuA2019 = "DNAmTL", ZhangY2017 = "Zhang Y 2017 (mortality)", PCGrimAge = "PCGrimAge", PCPhenoAge = "PCPhenoAge", PCHorvathS2013 = "PCHorvath 2013",
                 PCHannumG2013 = "PCHannum 2013", PCHorvathS2018 = "PCSkin and blood 2018", FuentealbaM2025 = "Fuentealba 2025", DunedinPACE = "DunedinPACE", epiTOC2 = "epiTOC2")
clock_name <- function(code) {
    code <- as.character(code)
    ifelse(code %in% names(clock_names), unname(clock_names[code]), code)
}
# A measure: a clock or its acceleration, or a score
measure_name <- function(measure) {
    measure <- as.character(measure)
    accelerated <- endsWith(measure, " acceleration")
    name <- clock_name(sub(" acceleration$", "", measure))
    paste0(ifelse(startsWith(name, "dnam_"), paste(sub("^dnam_", "", name), "score"), name), ifelse(accelerated, " acceleration", ""))
}
# knitr::kable rounds every number to 7 decimals, which prints small P-values
# as 0: format numbers to 4 significant digits instead (scientific below 0.001)
format_number <- function(v) vapply(v, function(z) {
    if (is.na(z)) return(NA_character_)
    if (is.finite(z) && z == round(z) && abs(z) < 1e15) return(format(z, scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE))
    if (is.finite(z) && z != 0 && abs(z) < 1e-3) return(formatC(z, digits = 2, format = "e"))
    format(signif(z, 4), scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE, drop0trailing = TRUE)
}, character(1))
# Every table is a numbered toggle: its bold name is shown, the whole table
# opens on a click
table_number <- 0
kable <- function(x, ..., caption = "Table", align = NULL) {
    x <- as.data.frame(x, check.names = FALSE)
    numeric_columns <- vapply(x, is.numeric, logical(1))
    for (j in which(vapply(x, is.double, logical(1)))) x[[j]] <- format_number(x[[j]])
    table <- knitr::kable(x, format = "pipe", ..., align = if (is.null(align)) ifelse(numeric_columns, "r", "l") else align)
    table_number <<- table_number + 1
    name <- htmltools::htmlEscape(sub("[.]$", "", caption))
    structure(paste0("\n\n<details class=\"report-table\">\n<summary><strong>Table ", table_number, ". ", name, "</strong> (",
                              nrow(x), if (nrow(x) == 1) " row" else " rows", ")</summary>\n\n", paste(table, collapse = "\n"), "\n\n</details>\n\n"), class = c("report_table", "knit_asis"))
}
# print() of a table inside a loop writes it as it is, like a table at the top level
print.report_table <- function(x, ...) cat(x)
# Every figure: saved as a 300 dpi PNG and a vector PDF in figures/ (for
# papers) and shown sharp at any zoom: as a vector SVG, or as the 300 dpi PNG
# when it has so many points that an SVG would be slow, with a numbered
# caption below it. The plot's title and subtitle become the caption and are
# left out of the image.
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("report_figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
figure_number <- 0
slug <- function(text) substr(gsub("(^_|_$)", "", gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "_", tolower(text))), 1, 60)
plot_rows <- function(plot) {
    rows <- if (is.data.frame(plot[["data"]])) nrow(plot[["data"]]) else 0
    for (layer in plot[["layers"]]) if (is.data.frame(layer[["data"]])) rows <- rows + nrow(layer[["data"]])
    rows
}
show_plot <- function(plot, width = NULL, height = NULL, description = NULL) {
    width <- if (is.null(width)) knitr::opts_current$get("fig.width") else width
    height <- if (is.null(height)) knitr::opts_current$get("fig.height") else height
    # ggsave refuses figures above 50 inches: cap the size instead of stopping the report
    width <- min(width, 49)
    height <- min(height, 49)
    figure_number <<- figure_number + 1
    title <- plot[["labels"]][["title"]]
    subtitle <- plot[["labels"]][["subtitle"]]
    caption <- paste(c(if (!is.null(title)) paste0(sub("[.]$", "", title), "."), subtitle, description), collapse = " ")
    plot <- plot + labs(title = NULL, subtitle = NULL)
    name <- sprintf("figure_%02d_%s", figure_number, slug(if (is.null(title)) "figure" else title))
    png_file <- file.path("figures", paste0(name, ".png"))
    ggsave(png_file, plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    ggsave(file.path("figures", paste0(name, ".pdf")), plot, width = width, height = height, bg = "white")
    shown <- png_file
    if (plot_rows(plot) <= 5000) {
        shown <- file.path("report_figures", paste0(name, ".svg"))
        grDevices::svg(shown, width = width, height = height, bg = "white")
        print(plot)
        grDevices::dev.off()
    }
    cat("\n\n![**Figure ", figure_number, ".** ", gsub("\n", " ", caption), "](", shown, "){.report-figure style=\"max-width: ",
        round(120 * width), "px\"}\n\n", sep = "")
}
# UpSet plot (Lex et al. 2014) of which items are in several sets at once. members:
# one row per item and set. Bars on top count the items of each combination (an
# item is in exactly one), filled dots below name its sets, bars on the left give
# the whole sets. Combinations of fewer than min_sets sets are left out.
upset_plot <- function(members, title, unit, subtitle = NULL, top = 25, min_sets = 1) {
    members <- unique(members[, .(item = as.character(item), set = as.character(set))])
    if (nrow(members) == 0) return(NULL)
    setorder(members, item, set)
    sizes <- members[, .(size = .N), by = set][order(-size, set)][, y := -seq_len(.N)]
    combinations <- members[, .(pattern = paste(set, collapse = "\t"), sets = .N), by = item][, .(n = .N), by = .(pattern, sets)]
    combinations <- combinations[sets >= min_sets][order(-n, sets, pattern)]
    if (nrow(combinations) == 0) return(NULL)
    shown <- head(combinations, top)[, x := seq_len(.N)]
    hidden <- combinations[-seq_len(nrow(shown))]
    used <- sizes
    dots <- shown[, .(set = strsplit(pattern, "\t", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]), by = .(x, sets)]
    dots <- merge(dots, used[, .(set, y)], by = "set")
    columns <- c("size", "combination")
    panel <- function(d, column, row) copy(d)[, `:=`(column = factor(column, columns), row = factor(row, c("bars", "sets")))]
    n_text <- function(n) format(n, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)
    steep <- nrow(shown) > 12 && max(shown[["n"]]) >= 1000
    stripes <- panel(used, "combination", "sets")[y %% 2 == 0]
    label <- data.table(x = 0, y = max(shown[["n"]]) / 2, text = paste0(unit, "\nin the\ncombination"))
    ggplot() +
        geom_rect(data = stripes, aes(xmin = 0.4, xmax = nrow(shown) + 0.6, ymin = y - 0.5, ymax = y + 0.5), fill = "grey95") +
        geom_col(data = panel(shown, "combination", "bars"), aes(x, n, fill = sets > 1), width = 0.65) +
        geom_text(data = panel(shown, "combination", "bars"), aes(x, n, label = n_text(n)), angle = if (steep) 90 else 0,
                  hjust = if (steep) -0.15 else 0.5, vjust = if (steep) 0.5 else -0.4, size = 2.8) +
        geom_blank(data = panel(shown, "combination", "bars"), aes(x, (if (steep) 1.28 else 1.12) * max(n))) +
        geom_point(data = panel(CJ(x = shown[["x"]], y = used[["y"]]), "combination", "sets"), aes(x, y), colour = "grey82", size = 1.8) +
        geom_segment(data = panel(dots[, .(low = min(y), high = max(y)), by = x], "combination", "sets"), aes(x = x, xend = x, y = low, yend = high), linewidth = 0.7, colour = "grey20") +
        geom_point(data = panel(dots, "combination", "sets"), aes(x, y, colour = sets > 1), size = 2.4) +
        geom_col(data = panel(used, "size", "sets"), aes(-size, y), orientation = "y", width = 0.6, fill = "#dd8452") +
        geom_text(data = panel(used, "size", "sets"), aes(-size, y, label = n_text(size)), hjust = 1.15, size = 2.8) +
        geom_blank(data = panel(used, "size", "sets"), aes(-1.5 * max(size), y)) +
        geom_text(data = panel(label, "size", "bars"), aes(x, y, label = text), hjust = 1, size = 3, lineheight = 0.95) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "grey60", `TRUE` = "#4c72b0"), guide = "none") +
        scale_colour_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "grey20", `TRUE` = "grey20"), guide = "none") +
        scale_x_continuous(breaks = NULL, expand = expansion(mult = 0, add = 0)) +
        scale_y_continuous(breaks = function(l) if (max(l) <= 0) used[["y"]] else pretty(c(0, l), 4),
                           labels = function(b) if (length(b) > 0 && all(b < 0, na.rm = TRUE)) used[["set"]][match(b, used[["y"]])] else n_text(b),
                           expand = expansion(mult = 0, add = 0)) +
        facet_grid(row ~ column, scales = "free") +
        theme(strip.text = element_blank(), strip.background = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.border = element_blank(),
              axis.ticks = element_blank(), panel.spacing = unit(0.3, "lines"), axis.title.x = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 8.5),
              panel.widths = unit(c(1, 3.4), "null"), panel.heights = unit(c(2.2, 0.32 * nrow(used)), "null")) +
        labs(x = paste(unit, "in the whole set"), y = NULL, title = title,
             subtitle = paste(c(subtitle, "Bars on top:", if (unit == "CpGs") unit else tolower(unit), "in exactly the sets with a filled dot (blue: more than one set).",
                                if (nrow(hidden) > 0) sprintf("%d smaller combinations (%s in all) are not drawn.", nrow(hidden), n_text(sum(hidden[["n"]])))), collapse = " "))
}
upset_height <- function(plot) if (is.null(plot)) 4 else 2.9 + 0.3 * length(unique(unlist(lapply(plot[["layers"]], function(layer) if ("set" %in% names(layer[["data"]])) layer[["data"]][["set"]]))))
# Plain names of the probe filter steps
step_names <- c(probe_type = "Not a CpG probe (rs, nv, control)", non_cg = "Non-CG (ch) probe", no_position = "No hg38 position", sex_chromosome = "Sex chromosome",
                detection = "Detection", bead_or_quality_mask = "Beads or quality mask", snp = "SNP", zhou_general_mask = "Zhou general mask",
                cross_hybridisation = "Cross-hybridisation", illumina_flagged = "Flagged by Illumina", illumina_mapping_inaccuracy = "Illumina mapping inaccuracy",
                exclusion_list = "Exclusion list", replicate_probe = "Replicate probe", mismatch_pos = "Manifest position mismatch", zhou_uncorr_titration = "Poor titration (Zhou)")
step_label <- function(step) ifelse(step %in% names(step_names), unname(step_names[step]), step)
# Combinations of missing values (missing: names separated by semicolons) as items of sets
missing_members <- function(table) {
    table <- table[!is.na(missing) & nzchar(missing)]
    if (nrow(table) == 0) return(data.table(item = character(), set = character()))
    table[, .(set = strsplit(missing, ";", fixed = TRUE)[[1]], arrays = arrays), by = .(row = seq_len(nrow(table)))][
        , .(item = paste(row, seq_len(arrays))), by = .(row, set, arrays)][, .(item, set)]
}
# Directional Manhattan plots (as in Uddin et al. 2022, Fig. 1a): -log10 P
# times the sign of the effect, so CpGs with higher methylation point up and
# those with lower methylation point down. Every CpG with P < 0.01 is drawn, and
# every 20th of the others; CpGs at FDR < 0.05 are coloured by direction.
chromosome_levels <- c(1:22, "X", "Y")
manhattan_points <- function(d, effect) {
    d <- d[!is.na(chr) & !is.na(pos) & !is.na(p_value) & !is.na(get(effect))]
    d[, chromosome := factor(sub("^chr", "", chr), levels = chromosome_levels)]
    d <- d[!is.na(chromosome) & (p_value < 0.01 | seq_len(.N) %% 20 == 0)]
    d[, signed := sign(get(effect)) * -log10(pmax(p_value, 1e-300))]
    d[, direction := ifelse(get(effect) > 0, "higher", "lower")]
    d
}
threshold_lines <- function(d) {
    lines <- data.table(y = -log10(as.numeric(param("p_epigenome_wide"))), line = paste0("P = ", param("p_epigenome_wide"), " (epigenome-wide)"))
    if ("fdr" %in% names(d) && any(d[["fdr"]] < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)) lines <- rbind(lines, data.table(y = -log10(max(d[fdr < 0.05, p_value])), line = "FDR = 0.05"))
    lines <- lines[is.finite(y)]
    rbind(lines, copy(lines)[, y := -y])
}
direction_colours <- c(higher = "#c44e52", lower = "#4c72b0")
manhattan_colours <- c(`FDR < 0.05, higher` = "#b2182b", `FDR < 0.05, lower` = "#2166ac", `not significant, odd chromosome` = "grey35",
                       `not significant, even chromosome` = "grey70")
directional_genome <- function(d, lines, title) {
    ends <- d[, .(end = max(pos)), by = chromosome][order(chromosome)]
    ends[, offset := c(0, head(cumsum(as.numeric(end) + 5e6), -1))]
    d <- merge(d, ends[, .(chromosome, offset)], by = "chromosome")
    d[, x := (pos + offset) / 1e6]
    significant <- if ("fdr" %in% names(d)) !is.na(d[["fdr"]]) & d[["fdr"]] < 0.05 else rep(FALSE, nrow(d))
    d[, class := ifelse(significant, paste0("FDR < 0.05, ", direction),
                        ifelse(as.integer(chromosome) %% 2 == 1, "not significant, odd chromosome", "not significant, even chromosome"))]
    d[, class := factor(class, levels = names(manhattan_colours))]
    setorder(d, class)
    d <- d[order(-as.integer(class))]
    centres <- d[, .(x = mean(range(x))), by = chromosome]
    ggplot(d, aes(x, signed, colour = class)) + geom_point(size = 0.7, show.legend = c(colour = TRUE, linetype = FALSE)) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.3) +
        geom_hline(data = lines, aes(yintercept = y, linetype = line), colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.4, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
        scale_colour_manual(values = manhattan_colours, breaks = c("FDR < 0.05, higher", "FDR < 0.05, lower"),
                            labels = c("Higher methylation (FDR < 0.05)", "Lower methylation (FDR < 0.05)"), drop = FALSE) +
        scale_linetype_manual(values = setNames(c(1, 2), c(paste0("P = ", param("p_epigenome_wide"), " (epigenome-wide)"), "FDR = 0.05"))) +
        scale_x_continuous(breaks = centres[["x"]], labels = as.character(centres[["chromosome"]]), expand = expansion(mult = 0.01)) +
        scale_y_continuous(labels = function(y) format(abs(y)), expand = expansion(mult = 0.05)) +
        guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2.5))) +
        theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8), legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "vertical") +
        labs(x = "Chromosome", y = expression(-log[10](italic(P)) ~ "(up: higher, down: lower)"), colour = NULL, linetype = NULL, title = title,
             subtitle = "Upwards: higher methylation; downwards: lower. Of the CpGs with P >= 0.01, every 20th is drawn.")
}
# Top CpGs with higher and with lower methylation, as two tables
top_by_direction <- function(d, effect, columns, caption, n = 20) {
    for (direction in c("higher", "lower")) {
        part <- if (direction == "higher") d[get(effect) > 0] else d[get(effect) < 0]
        part <- head(part[order(p_value)], n)
        if (nrow(part) == 0) next
        print(kable(part[, columns, with = FALSE], col.names = names(columns),
                    caption = paste0(caption, ": the ", nrow(part), " CpGs with ", direction, " methylation and the smallest P")))
    }
}
# Interpretation of association results (todo section 2e: I1, I3, I4, I5),
# after Uddin et al. 2022 and Kirmani et al. 2025
significant_direction <- function(d, effect) {
    ifelse(!is.na(d[["fdr"]]) & d[["fdr"]] < 0.05, ifelse(d[[effect]] > 0, "higher", "lower"), "not significant")
}
# Labels of the volcano plot: the n CpGs at FDR < 0.05 with the smallest P in each
# direction, in a column beside the points (lower methylation left, higher right).
# Within a column the labels keep the order of their points and are evenly spaced,
# so they never overlap, without a label-repelling package.
volcano_labels <- function(d, effect, n = 10) {
    d <- d[!is.na(p_value) & !is.na(get(effect)) & !is.na(fdr) & fdr < 0.05 & get(effect) != 0]
    if (nrow(d) == 0) return(NULL)
    d[, y := -log10(pmax(p_value, 1e-300))]
    gene_name <- if ("gene" %in% names(d)) sub(";.*", "", d[["gene"]]) else rep(NA_character_, nrow(d))
    d[, label := ifelse(is.na(gene_name) | gene_name == "", cpg_id, paste0(cpg_id, " (", gene_name, ")"))]
    pick <- rbind(head(d[get(effect) < 0][order(p_value)], n)[, side := "lower"],
                  head(d[get(effect) > 0][order(p_value)], n)[, side := "higher"])
    x_range <- range(d[[effect]], 0)
    width <- diff(x_range)
    y_top <- max(d[["y"]])
    pick[, x := get(effect)]
    pick[, label_x := ifelse(side == "lower", x_range[1] - 0.06 * width, x_range[2] + 0.06 * width)]
    pick[, label_y := {
        slots <- seq(min(y), max(y_top, min(y) + 0.06 * y_top * .N), length.out = .N)
        slots[rank(y, ties.method = "first")]
    }, by = side]
    pick[, hjust := ifelse(side == "lower", 1, 0)]
    pick[]
}
volcano_plot <- function(d, effect, effect_label, title) {
    d <- d[!is.na(p_value) & !is.na(get(effect))]
    labelled <- volcano_labels(d, effect)
    d[, class := factor(significant_direction(d, effect), levels = c("higher", "lower", "not significant"))]
    d <- d[class != "not significant" | p_value < 0.01 | seq_len(.N) %% 10 == 0][order(-as.integer(class))]
    lines <- data.table(y = -log10(as.numeric(param("p_epigenome_wide"))), line = paste0("P = ", param("p_epigenome_wide"), " (epigenome-wide)"))
    if (any(d[["class"]] != "not significant")) lines <- rbind(lines, data.table(y = -log10(max(d[class != "not significant", p_value])), line = "FDR = 0.05"))
    plot <- ggplot(d, aes(get(effect), -log10(pmax(p_value, 1e-300)), colour = class)) + geom_point(size = 0.7, show.legend = c(colour = TRUE, linetype = FALSE)) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
        geom_hline(data = lines, aes(yintercept = y, linetype = line), colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.4, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
        scale_colour_manual(values = c(higher = "#b2182b", lower = "#2166ac", `not significant` = "grey70"), drop = FALSE,
                            labels = c(higher = "Higher methylation (FDR < 0.05)", lower = "Lower methylation (FDR < 0.05)", `not significant` = "Not significant")) +
        scale_linetype_manual(values = setNames(c(1, 2), c(paste0("P = ", param("p_epigenome_wide"), " (epigenome-wide)"), "FDR = 0.05"))) +
        guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2.5))) +
        theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "vertical") +
        labs(x = effect_label, y = expression(-log[10](italic(P))), colour = NULL, linetype = NULL, title = title,
             subtitle = paste0("Of the CpGs with P >= 0.01, every 10th is drawn.",
                               if (!is.null(labelled)) " Labelled: in each direction, the 10 CpGs at FDR < 0.05 with the smallest P." else ""))
    if (is.null(labelled)) return(plot)
    plot + geom_segment(data = labelled, aes(x = x, y = y, xend = label_x, yend = label_y), colour = "grey45", linewidth = 0.25, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
        geom_point(data = labelled, aes(x, y), shape = 21, size = 1.6, colour = "black", fill = NA, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
        geom_text(data = labelled, aes(label_x, label_y, label = label, hjust = hjust), size = 2.3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
        scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.35))
}
# I3: hits by direction, with a binomial test of the balance
direction_summary <- function(d, effect) {
    hits <- !is.na(d[["fdr"]]) & d[["fdr"]] < 0.05
    higher <- sum(hits & d[[effect]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    lower <- sum(hits & d[[effect]] < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    data.table(`CpGs tested` = nrow(d), `Hits (FDR < 0.05)` = higher + lower,
               Higher = higher, `Higher (% of tested)` = round(100 * higher / nrow(d), 3),
               Lower = lower, `Lower (% of tested)` = round(100 * lower / nrow(d), 3),
               `Share higher` = if (higher + lower > 0) round(higher / (higher + lower), 3) else NA_real_,
               `Binomial P (balance)` = if (higher + lower > 0) binom.test(higher, higher + lower)[["p.value"]] else NA_real_)
}
# I4: genomic context of the hits by direction, against all tested CpGs
context_categories <- function(d) {
    cgi <- d[["cgi_relation"]]
    cgi[is.na(cgi)] <- ""
    feature <- d[["gene_group"]]
    feature[is.na(feature)] <- ""
    gene <- d[["gene"]]
    gene[is.na(gene)] <- ""
    list(
        `CpG island context` = list(
            Island = grepl("Island", cgi), Shore = grepl("Shore", cgi), Shelf = grepl("Shelf", cgi), `Open sea` = cgi == ""),
        `Gene feature` = list(
            TSS1500 = grepl("TSS1500", feature), TSS200 = grepl("TSS200", feature), `5'UTR` = grepl("5UTR", feature),
            `First exon` = grepl("exon_1(;|$)", feature), `Other exons` = grepl("exon_([2-9]|[1-9][0-9]+)(;|$)", feature),
            `3'UTR` = grepl("3UTR", feature), `Intron or other gene part` = feature == "" & gene != "", Intergenic = feature == "" & gene == "")
    )
}
context_enrichment <- function(d, effect) {
    if (!all(c("cgi_relation", "gene_group", "gene") %in% names(d))) return(data.table())
    direction <- significant_direction(d, effect)
    categories <- context_categories(d)
    rbindlist(lapply(c("all hits", "higher", "lower"), function(query_name) {
        query <- if (query_name == "all hits") direction != "not significant" else direction == query_name
        if (sum(query) < 5) return(NULL)
        rbindlist(lapply(names(categories), function(group) rbindlist(lapply(names(categories[[group]]), function(category) {
            member <- categories[[group]][[category]]
            test <- fisher.test(matrix(c(sum(query & member), sum(query & !member), sum(!query & member), sum(!query & !member)), 2))
            data.table(group = group, category = category, query = query_name, hits_in = sum(query & member), hits = sum(query),
                       share_hits = sum(query & member) / sum(query), share_tested = mean(member),
                       odds_ratio = unname(test[["estimate"]]), ci_low = test[["conf.int"]][1], ci_high = test[["conf.int"]][2], p_value = test[["p.value"]])
        }))))
    }))
}
context_plot <- function(table, title) {
    table <- copy(table)[is.finite(odds_ratio) & odds_ratio > 0]
    if (nrow(table) == 0) return(NULL)
    table[, category := factor(category, levels = rev(unique(category)))]
    table[, query := factor(query, levels = c("all hits", "higher", "lower"), labels = c("All hits", "Higher methylation", "Lower methylation"))]
    table[, ci_low := pmax(ci_low, 1e-3)]
    table[, ci_high := pmin(ci_high, 1e3)]
    ggplot(table, aes(odds_ratio, category, colour = query)) + geom_vline(xintercept = 1, colour = "grey40", linetype = 2) +
        geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = ci_low, xmax = ci_high), position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 0.3) +
        scale_x_log10() + scale_colour_manual(values = c(`All hits` = "grey25", `Higher methylation` = "#b2182b", `Lower methylation` = "#2166ac")) +
        facet_grid(group ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") + theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0)) +
        labs(x = "Odds ratio against all tested CpGs (log scale)", y = NULL, colour = NULL, title = title,
             subtitle = "Fisher's exact test; bars: 95% confidence intervals. Above 1: more hits than expected.")
}
# I5: methylation level of the hits
level_plot <- function(d, effect, title) {
    if (!"mean_beta" %in% names(d)) return(NULL)
    direction <- significant_direction(d, effect)
    groups <- rbind(data.table(group = "All tested CpGs", mean_beta = d[["mean_beta"]][seq_len(nrow(d)) %% 10 == 0]),
                    data.table(group = "Higher methylation (FDR < 0.05)", mean_beta = d[["mean_beta"]][direction == "higher"]),
                    data.table(group = "Lower methylation (FDR < 0.05)", mean_beta = d[["mean_beta"]][direction == "lower"]))[!is.na(mean_beta)]
    counts <- groups[, .N, by = group]
    groups <- groups[group %in% counts[N >= 5, group]]
    if (uniqueN(groups[["group"]]) < 2) return(NULL)
    groups[, group := factor(group, levels = c("All tested CpGs", "Higher methylation (FDR < 0.05)", "Lower methylation (FDR < 0.05)"))]
    groups[, group := factor(group, levels = rev(levels(group)))]
    ggplot(groups, aes(mean_beta, group, fill = group)) + geom_violin(colour = NA, alpha = 0.6, scale = "width") +
        geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white") +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c(`All tested CpGs` = "grey60", `Higher methylation (FDR < 0.05)` = "#b2182b", `Lower methylation (FDR < 0.05)` = "#2166ac"), guide = "none") +
        scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10)) +
        labs(x = "Mean beta value over the arrays", y = NULL, title = title,
             subtitle = "Hits at intermediate levels are typical of CpGs that differ between blood cell types.")
}
# Template of a gene and its CpG island, with every genomic context category
# that the context figures use, to read them by (not to scale)
schematic_shown <- FALSE
context_schematic <- function() {
    island <- data.table(label = c("Open sea", "Shelf", "Shore", "Island", "Shore", "Shelf", "Open sea"),
                         start = c(0, 7, 15, 23, 39, 47, 55), end = c(7, 15, 23, 39, 47, 55, 124))
    island[, fill := label]
    promoter <- data.table(label = c("TSS1500", "TSS200", "5'UTR", "3'UTR"), start = c(14, 24, 31, 97), end = c(24, 31, 38, 108))
    promoter[, fill := label]
    body <- data.table(label = c("Intergenic", "First exon", "Intron or other\ngene part", "Other\nexons", "Intron", "Other\nexons", "Intron", "Other exons", "Intergenic"),
                       start = c(0, 31, 42, 58, 66, 76, 84, 92, 108), end = c(14, 42, 58, 66, 76, 84, 92, 108, 124))
    body[, fill := ifelse(grepl("^Intron", label), "Intron", ifelse(grepl("^Other", label), "Other exons", label))]
    tracks <- rbind(island[, y := 4], promoter[, y := 2], body[, y := 1])
    # the gene: exons as boxes (thin: untranslated, thick: coding), introns as a line
    exons <- data.table(start = c(31, 38, 58, 76, 92, 97), end = c(38, 42, 66, 84, 97, 108), h = c(0.12, 0.22, 0.22, 0.22, 0.22, 0.12))
    set.seed(3)
    cpgs <- data.table(x = c(seq(23.5, 38.5, by = 0.55), sort(runif(45, 0, 124))))
    colours <- c(Island = "#1b7837", Shore = "#7fbf7b", Shelf = "#d9f0d3", `Open sea` = "#f4f4f4",
                 TSS1500 = "#fdb863", TSS200 = "#e08214", `5'UTR` = "#b2abd2", `3'UTR` = "#8073ac",
                 `First exon` = "#2166ac", `Other exons` = "#67a9cf", Intron = "#d1e5f0", Intergenic = "#e6e6e6")
    text_colour <- c(Island = "white", TSS200 = "white", `First exon` = "white", `3'UTR` = "white")
    tracks[, ink := ifelse(fill %in% names(text_colour), "white", "grey15")]
    ggplot() +
        geom_rect(data = tracks, aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = y - 0.32, ymax = y + 0.32, fill = fill), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
        geom_text(data = tracks, aes(x = (start + end) / 2, y = y, label = label, colour = ink), size = 3.1, lineheight = 0.85) +
        geom_segment(data = cpgs, aes(x = x, xend = x, y = 4.42, yend = 4.62), linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey30") +
        annotate("segment", x = 0, xend = 124, y = 3, yend = 3, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4, linetype = 2) +
        annotate("segment", x = 31, xend = 108, y = 3, yend = 3, colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.8) +
        geom_rect(data = exons, aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = 3 - h, ymax = 3 + h), fill = "grey20") +
        annotate("segment", x = 31, xend = 31, y = 3.25, yend = 3.55, linewidth = 0.6) +
        annotate("segment", x = 31, xend = 35, y = 3.55, yend = 3.55, linewidth = 0.6, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.12, "cm"), type = "closed")) +
        annotate("text", x = 36.6, y = 3.55, label = "TSS (transcription start site)", size = 3, hjust = 0) +
        annotate("text", x = 124, y = 3.3, label = "5' to 3'", size = 2.8, hjust = 1, colour = "grey30") +
        annotate("text", x = 0, y = 4.75, label = "CpGs (dense in the island)", size = 2.8, hjust = 0, colour = "grey30") +
        scale_fill_manual(values = colours, guide = "none") + scale_colour_identity() +
        scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(1, 2, 3, 4), labels = c("Exons and introns", "Promoters and UTRs", "Gene", "CpG island context"), limits = c(0.6, 4.85)) +
        scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.005)) +
        theme_void() + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 1, margin = margin(r = 6)), plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)) +
        labs(title = "How to read the genomic context: a gene and its CpG island",
             subtitle = paste("Not to scale. Shores: up to 2 kb from the island; shelves: 2 to 4 kb; open sea: farther away. TSS200 and TSS1500: up to 200 and 200 to 1,500 bp",
                              "upstream of the transcription start site (TSS). A CpG with several features, from different transcripts, counts in each."))
}
```

One run of the [methylarray](https://github.com/bhagesh-h/methylarray) pipeline`r if (nzchar(param("pipeline_version"))) paste0(", version ", param("pipeline_version")) else ""` (DOI [10.5281/zenodo.24399752](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24399752)). It shows aggregates only. Click a table's name to open it. All figures are also saved as PNG and PDF in `report/figures/`.

# Summary

```{r summary, results = "asis"}
qc <- if (has("^sample_qc\\.tsv$")) read(find("^sample_qc\\.tsv$")) else NULL
ewas <- if (has("^ewas_summary\\.tsv$")) read(find("^ewas_summary\\.tsv$")) else NULL
key <- list()
add_key <- function(topic, result, section) key[[length(key) + 1]] <<- data.table(Topic = topic, Result = result, Section = section)
if (!is.null(qc)) {
    kept <- sum(qc[["status"]] %in% c("PASS", "FLAG"))
    add_key("Arrays", sprintf("%d of %d kept; %d flagged, %d failed, %d excluded in the samplesheet", kept, nrow(qc), sum(qc[["status"]] == "FLAG"),
                              sum(qc[["status"]] == "FAIL"), sum(qc[["status"]] == "EXCLUDED")), "[Samples](#samples)")
}
if (has("_filtered_attrition\\.tsv$")) {
    attrition <- read(find("_filtered_attrition\\.tsv$")[1])
    add_key("Probes", sprintf("%s of %s kept", big(tail(attrition[!startsWith(step, "report_only_"), remaining], 1)), big(attrition[step == "start", remaining])), "[Probes](#probes)")
}
if (has("^cell_fractions_reference_coverage\\.tsv$")) {
    rc <- read(find("^cell_fractions_reference_coverage\\.tsv$"))
    add_key("Cell composition", paste(sprintf("%.1f%% of the %s reference CpGs found", 100 * rc[["coverage"]][1], rc[["reference"]][1])), "[Cell composition](#cell-composition)")
}
clocks <- if (has("^clocks\\.tsv$")) read(find("^clocks\\.tsv$")) else NULL
clock_values <- if (is.null(clocks)) character() else setdiff(names(clocks), c("sample", "age", grep("^i?eaa_", names(clocks), value = TRUE)))
age_agreement <- data.table()
if (!is.null(clocks) && sum(!is.na(clocks[["age"]])) >= 3) {
    age_agreement <- rbindlist(lapply(clock_values, function(clock) {
        ok <- !is.na(clocks[[clock]]) & !is.na(clocks[["age"]])
        if (sum(ok) < 3) return(NULL)
        data.table(Clock = clock, Name = clock_name(clock), Arrays = sum(ok), `Pearson r with age` = round(cor(clocks[[clock]][ok], clocks[["age"]][ok]), 3))
    }))
}
if (!is.null(clocks)) {
    best <- age_agreement[order(-`Pearson r with age`)][1]
    add_key("Clocks", paste0(length(clock_values), " clocks", if (nrow(age_agreement) > 0) sprintf("; closest to the reported age: %s (r = %.2f)", best[["Name"]], best[["Pearson r with age"]])),
            "[Clocks and scores](#clocks-and-scores)")
}
if (has("^biomarkers_phenotypes\\.tsv$")) {
    tested <- read(find("^biomarkers_phenotypes\\.tsv$"))[version == "plain" & !trait %in% c("Age", "Men")]
    if (nrow(tested) > 0) add_key("Phenotypes", sprintf("%d of %d tests of a clock or score against a phenotype at q < 0.05", sum(tested[["q"]] < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), nrow(tested)),
                                  "[Phenotypes](#phenotypes)")
}
if (!is.null(ewas)) {
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(ewas))) {
        row <- ewas[i]
        add_key(paste("Model", row[["model"]]), if (row[["status"]] != "tested") row[["status"]] else
                sprintf("%s: %s CpGs at FDR < 0.05, lambda %.2f, %d arrays", row[["contrast"]], big(row[["hits_fdr"]]), row[["lambda"]], row[["n"]]),
                sprintf("[Model %s](#%s)", row[["model"]], model_id(row[["model"]])))
    }
}
if (length(key) > 0) cat("\n\n", paste(knitr::kable(rbindlist(key), format = "pipe"), collapse = "\n"), "\n\n", sep = "")
settings <- c(preprocessing = "Preprocessing", minfi_norm = "Normalisation (minfi)", platform = "Platform", detection_pval = "Detection P", min_beads = "Beads per value (minimum)",
              probe_filters = "Probe filters", crosshyb_filter = "Cross-hybridisation filter", snp_mask = "SNP mask", keep_sex_chr = "Sex chromosomes kept", illumina_filter = "Illumina lists removed",
              replicate_probe_strategy = "Replicate probes", ewas_cells = "Cell fractions of the models", ewas_outlier_iqr = "Outlier fence (IQR, 0 = none)")
settings <- settings[vapply(names(settings), function(name) nzchar(param(name)), logical(1))]
if (length(settings) > 0) print(kable(data.table(Setting = unname(settings), Value = vapply(names(settings), param, character(1))), caption = "Main settings of the run"))
```

```{r snp, results = "asis", fig.width = 11, fig.height = 7, eval = has("^ewastools_snp_summary\\.tsv$")}
heading("SNP genotypes")

hist_snp <- if (has("^ewastools_snp_histograms\\.tsv$")) read(find("^ewastools_snp_histograms\\.tsv$")) else NULL
threshold <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(param("snp_outlier_threshold")))

            sprintf("%d arrays share more than 90%% of their genotypes with another array (highest agreement %.2f, median of the highest %.2f).",
                    sum(snp[["max_agreement"]] > 0.9, na.rm = TRUE), max(snp[["max_agreement"]], na.rm = TRUE), median(snp[["max_agreement"]], na.rm = TRUE)),
            sprintf("%d arrays above the SNP outlier threshold of %s (possible contamination).", sum(snp[["snp_outlier"]] > threshold, na.rm = TRUE), param("snp_outlier_threshold")))
bullets(points)
panels <- list()
if (!is.null(hist_snp) && nrow(hist_snp) > 0) {
    panels[["Beta values"]] <- function() show_plot(ggplot(hist_snp[histogram == "snp_beta"], aes((bin_start + bin_end) / 2, count)) + geom_col(fill = "#4c72b0", width = 0.02) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = c(0.2, 0.8), linetype = 2, colour = "#c44e52") + labs(x = "Beta value of the autosomal SNP probes", y = "Genotype calls", title = "Beta values of the autosomal SNP probes", subtitle = "Three peaks are expected, one per genotype. Dashed lines: limits of the genotype calls."))
    panels[["Agreement"]] <- function() show_plot(ggplot(hist_snp[histogram == "pair_agreement"], aes((bin_start + bin_end) / 2, count)) + geom_col(fill = "#55a868", width = 0.02) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = 0.9, linetype = 2, colour = "#c44e52") + labs(x = "Share of identical genotypes", y = "Pairs of arrays", title = "Genotype agreement of every pair of arrays", subtitle = "Pairs above the dashed line are most likely the same person."))
}
if (any(!is.na(snp[["het_share_x"]]))) {
    panels[["X heterozygosity"]] <- function() show_plot(ggplot(snp[!is.na(het_share_x) & sex_used %in% c("M", "F")], aes(ifelse(sex_used == "M", "Men", "Women"), het_share_x)) +
        geom_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0, alpha = 0.5, colour = "#8172b3") + labs(x = "Sex used for the check", y = "Share of heterozygous X-chromosome SNPs", title = "Heterozygosity at the X-chromosome SNPs by sex", subtitle = "A man with many heterozygous calls suggests contamination or a swap."))
}
panels[["Outlier score"]] <- function() show_plot(ggplot(snp, aes(snp_outlier)) + geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "#dd8452") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = threshold, linetype = 2, colour = "#c44e52") +
    labs(x = "SNP outlier score (higher: more likely contaminated)", y = "Arrays", title = "SNP outlier score of every array", subtitle = "Arrays above the dashed line fail QC."))
tabs(panels)
```

```{r relatedness, results = "asis", fig.width = 9, fig.height = 6, eval = has("^ewastools_relatedness\\.tsv\\.gz$") && has("^ewastools_relatedness_summary\\.tsv$")}
heading("Relatedness")
rs <- read(find("^ewastools_relatedness_summary\\.tsv$"))
rv <- setNames(rs[["value"]], rs[["metric"]])
pairs <- read(find("^ewastools_relatedness\\.tsv\\.gz$"))
low_power <- is.finite(as.numeric(rv[["expected_lod_first_degree"]])) && as.numeric(rv[["expected_lod_first_degree"]]) < as.numeric(rv[["lod_threshold"]])
bullets(c(sprintf("%s pairs of %s arrays, compared at %s autosomal SNPs.", big(as.numeric(rv[["pairs"]])), rv[["arrays"]], rv[["snps"]]),
          sprintf("Identical pairs: %s, of them %s from different expected donors. First-degree pairs: %s. Replicate pairs that are not identical: %s.",
                  rv[["identical_pairs"]], rv[["identical_pairs_unexpected"]], rv[["first_degree_pairs"]], rv[["replicate_pairs_not_identical"]]),
          sprintf("A pair counts as related when its log10 likelihood ratio against unrelated exceeds %s.", rv[["lod_threshold"]]),
          if (low_power) sprintf("Most first-degree relatives are missed: with these SNPs a true first-degree pair reaches only %s, below the threshold. Identical pairs are found reliably.",
                                 rv[["expected_lod_first_degree"]])))
if (nrow(pairs) > 0) {
    pairs[, Relation := factor(relation, levels = c("unrelated", "first-degree", "identical", "too few SNPs"))]
    setorder(pairs, Relation)
    show_plot(ggplot(pairs, aes(ibs_mean, ibs_var, colour = Relation)) +
        geom_point(size = 0.8, alpha = 0.6, show.legend = TRUE) +
        geom_point(data = pairs[expected_same_donor == TRUE], shape = 1, size = 3, colour = "black") +
        scale_colour_manual(values = c(unrelated = "#999999", `first-degree` = "#dd8452", identical = "#c44e52", `too few SNPs` = "#cccccc"), drop = FALSE) +
        guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2.5, alpha = 1))) +
        labs(x = "Mean identity by state (alleles shared per SNP)", y = "Variance of identity by state", colour = "Inferred relation",
             title = "Relatedness of every pair of arrays", subtitle = "Black circles: pairs expected to be the same donor."))
    shown <- pairs[relation %in% c("identical", "first-degree") | expected_same_donor == TRUE]
    if (nrow(shown) > 0) {
        print(kable(shown[, .(`Array 1` = sample1, `Array 2` = sample2, Relation = relation, `Same donor expected` = ifelse(expected_same_donor, "yes", "no"),
                              `IBS mean` = ibs_mean, `LOD identical` = lod_identical, `LOD first-degree` = lod_first_degree)],
                    caption = "Related pairs and expected replicate pairs"))
    }
}
```

```{r ancestry, results = "asis", fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5, eval = has("^ancestry_pcs_summary\\.tsv$")}
heading("Genetic ancestry")
as_summary <- read(find("^ancestry_pcs_summary\\.tsv$"))
av <- setNames(as.character(as_summary[["value"]]), as_summary[["metric"]])
if ("note" %in% names(av)) {
    cat(av[["note"]], "\n\n")
} else {
    cat(sprintf("Components from %s CpG probes with a common SNP and %s rs probes (EpiAnceR+), after removing the effect of %s. The components marked as covariates enter models with `@ancestry`.\n\n",
                av[["snp_cpgs"]], av[["rs_snps"]], av[["residualised_for"]]))
    panels <- list()
    pcs <- read(find("^ancestry_pcs\\.tsv$"))
    if (all(c("ancestry_pc1", "ancestry_pc2") %in% names(pcs))) {
        panels[["PC1 and PC2"]] <- function() show_plot(ggplot(pcs, aes(ancestry_pc1, ancestry_pc2)) + geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7, colour = "#4c72b0") +
            labs(x = "Ancestry PC1", y = "Ancestry PC2", title = "Arrays on the first two genetic ancestry components", subtitle = "Clusters suggest groups of different ancestry."))
    }
    if (has("^ancestry_pcs_variance\\.tsv$")) {
        av_var <- read(find("^ancestry_pcs_variance\\.tsv$"))
        av_var[, pc := factor(sub("ancestry_", "", pc), levels = sub("ancestry_", "", pc))]
        panels[["Variance"]] <- function() show_plot(ggplot(av_var, aes(pc, 100 * variance_explained, fill = covariate)) + geom_col() +
            scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#4c72b0", `FALSE` = "#bbbbbb"), labels = c(`TRUE` = "@ancestry covariate", `FALSE` = "not used")) +
            labs(x = NULL, y = "Variance explained (%)", fill = NULL, title = "Variance of each ancestry component"))
    }
    if (has("^ancestry_pcs_associations\\.tsv$")) {
        aa <- read(find("^ancestry_pcs_associations\\.tsv$"))
        if (nrow(aa) > 0) {
            aa[, pc := factor(sub("ancestry_", "", pc), levels = unique(sub("ancestry_", "", pc)))]
            panels[["What they capture"]] <- function() show_plot(ggplot(aa, aes(pc, variable, fill = r_squared)) + geom_tile(colour = "white") +
                geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", r_squared)), size = 2.6) +
                scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#c44e52", limits = c(0, 1)) +
                labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "R-squared", title = "What the ancestry components capture",
                     subtitle = "Plate, BeadChip and row should explain little."))
        }
    }
    tabs(panels)
}
```

```{r attrition, results = "asis", eval = has("_filtered_attrition\\.tsv$")}
steps <- attrition[step != "start" & !startsWith(step, "report_only_")]
steps[, step := factor(step_label(step), levels = rev(step_label(step)))]
heading("Filter steps")
show_plot(ggplot(steps, aes(removed, step)) + geom_col(fill = "#4c72b0") +
    geom_text(aes(label = big(removed)), hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = big, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
    labs(x = "Probes removed", y = NULL, title = "Probes removed at each filter step",
         subtitle = "Steps in the order they are applied; a probe counts at the first step that removes it."), 8, 4.5)
print(kable(attrition[startsWith(step, "report_only_"), .(Flag = step_label(sub("report_only_", "", step)), `Kept probes with the flag` = n_with_reason)], caption = "Report-only flags: probes kept although flagged"))
if (has("_filtered_exclusions\\.tsv\\.gz$")) {
    exclusions <- read(find("_filtered_exclusions\\.tsv\\.gz$")[1])
    if (nrow(exclusions) > 0) {
        heading("Reasons for removing probes")
        several <- sum(grepl(";", exclusions[["reasons"]], fixed = TRUE))
        cat(sprintf("%s of the %s removed probes fail more than one step.\n\n", big(several), big(nrow(exclusions))))
        upset <- upset_plot(exclusions[, .(set = step_label(strsplit(reasons, ";", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])), by = .(item = probe_id)],
                            "Reasons for removing probes", "Probes", "All reasons of every removed probe.")
        show_plot(upset, 10, upset_height(upset))
    }
}
```

```{r clocks, results = "asis", eval = !is.null(clocks) || has("^dnam_scores_coverage\\.tsv$")}
part("Clocks and scores")
if (!is.null(clocks) && nrow(age_agreement) > 0) {
    heading("Agreement with the reported age")
    print(kable(age_agreement, caption = "Agreement of the clocks with the reported age"))
    main <- intersect(c("HorvathS2013", "HannumG2013", "LevineM2018", "HorvathS2018", "PCGrimAge", "PCPhenoAge"), clock_values)
    if (length(main) > 0) {
        long <- melt(clocks[, c("sample", "age", main), with = FALSE], id.vars = c("sample", "age"), variable.name = "clock")[is.finite(value) & is.finite(age)]
        long[, clock := factor(clock_name(clock), levels = clock_name(main))]
        show_plot(ggplot(long, aes(age, value)) + geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
            geom_point(size = 0.9, alpha = 0.6, colour = "#4c72b0") + geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE, colour = "#c44e52", linewidth = 0.6) +
            facet_wrap(~clock, scales = "free_y") +
            labs(x = "Reported age", y = "Clock estimate (years)", title = "Age clocks against the reported age", subtitle = "Dashed line: equal; red line: linear fit."))
    }
}
if (!is.null(clocks)) {
    accelerations <- grep("^eaa_", names(clocks), value = TRUE)
    if (length(accelerations) > 0) {
        heading("Age acceleration")
        long <- melt(clocks[, c("sample", accelerations), with = FALSE], id.vars = "sample", variable.name = "clock")[is.finite(value)]
        long[, clock := factor(clock_name(sub("^eaa_", "", clock)), levels = rev(clock_name(sub("^eaa_", "", accelerations))))]
        show_plot(ggplot(long, aes(value, clock)) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
            geom_violin(fill = "#4c72b0", colour = NA, alpha = 0.5, scale = "width") + geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.size = 0.6, fill = "white") +
            labs(x = "Age acceleration (years)", y = NULL, title = "Age acceleration over the arrays", subtitle = "Residual of the clock on the reported age; 0 is the value expected for the age."))
    }
}
if (has("^dnam_scores\\.tsv$")) {
    scores <- read(find("^dnam_scores\\.tsv$"))
    long <- melt(scores, id.vars = "sample", variable.name = "score")[is.finite(value)]
    if (nrow(long) > 0) {
        heading("DNA methylation scores")
        long[, score := sub("^dnam_", "", score)]
        show_plot(ggplot(long, aes(score, value)) + geom_violin(fill = "#dd8452", colour = NA, alpha = 0.5, scale = "width") +
            geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.size = 0.6, fill = "white") + facet_wrap(~score, scales = "free", nrow = 1) +
            theme(axis.text.x = element_blank()) +
            labs(x = NULL, y = "Score", title = "DNA methylation scores over the arrays", subtitle = "Each score on its own scale."))
    }
}
heading("CpGs measured")
if (has("^clocks_coverage\\.tsv$")) {
    coverage <- read(find("^clocks_coverage\\.tsv$"))
    print(kable(coverage[, .(Clock = clock, Name = clock_name(clock), CpGs = cpgs, Present = present, `Share present` = share_present,
                           `With a common SNP` = if ("snp_cpgs" %in% names(coverage)) snp_cpgs else NA, Note = note)], caption = "Clock coverage"))
}
if (has("^dnam_scores_coverage\\.tsv$")) {
    scores_coverage <- read(find("^dnam_scores_coverage\\.tsv$"))
    print(kable(scores_coverage[, .(Score = score, CpGs = cpgs, Present = present, `Share present` = share_present, Reference = reference)], caption = "DNA methylation score coverage"))
}
```

```{r clock-weights, results = "asis", fig.width = 12, fig.height = 12, eval = has("^clocks_weights\\.tsv$") || has("^dnam_scores_weights\\.tsv$")}
heading("Clock and score CpGs")
weights <- rbindlist(list(
    if (has("^clocks_weights\\.tsv$")) read(find("^clocks_weights\\.tsv$"))[, .(set = clock_name(clock), cpg, gene = as.character(gene), standardised)] else NULL,
    if (has("^dnam_scores_weights\\.tsv$")) read(find("^dnam_scores_weights\\.tsv$"))[, .(set = paste(score, "score"), cpg, gene = NA_character_, standardised)] else NULL
), fill = TRUE)
weights <- weights[is.finite(standardised)]
tests <- rbindlist(lapply(find("^ewas_.*_stats\\.tsv\\.gz$"), function(file) {
    x <- read(file)
    if (nrow(x) == 0) return(NULL)
    x[, .(model = model_of(file, "ewas_", "_stats\\.tsv\\.gz"), cpg = sub("_.*", "", cpg_id), hit = !is.na(fdr) & fdr < 0.05)]
}))
panels <- list()
if (nrow(weights) > 0) {
    top <- weights[order(-abs(standardised)), head(.SD, 12), by = set]
    top[, label := paste0(cpg, ifelse(is.na(gene) | gene == "", "", paste0(" (", gene, ")")))]
    top[, key := paste(set, label, sep = "__")]
    top[, key := factor(key, levels = rev(unique(key)))]
    panels[["Largest weights"]] <- function() show_plot(ggplot(top, aes(standardised, key, fill = standardised > 0)) + geom_col() +
        scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) sub("^.*__", "", x)) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#c44e52", `FALSE` = "#4c72b0"), labels = c(`TRUE` = "Positive weight", `FALSE` = "Negative weight"), name = NULL) +
        facet_wrap(~ set, scales = "free", ncol = 3) + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6), legend.position = "bottom") +
        labs(x = "Standardised weight (clock units per SD of beta)", y = NULL, title = "The 12 CpGs with the largest weight in each clock and score",
             subtitle = "Weight: published coefficient times the SD of the CpG in these arrays. Principal-component clocks and epiTOC2 have no weights per CpG."))
}
if (nrow(weights) > 0 && uniqueN(weights[["set"]]) > 1) {
    shared <- unique(weights[, .(item = cpg, set)])
    in_several <- shared[, .N, by = item][N > 1]
    upset_shared <- upset_plot(shared, "CpGs shared between the clocks and scores", "CpGs", min_sets = 2)
    if (!is.null(upset_shared)) panels[["Shared CpGs"]] <- function() {
        cat(sprintf("%s of the %s CpGs are in more than one clock or score, at most in %d.\n\n", big(nrow(in_several)), big(uniqueN(shared[["item"]])), max(in_several[["N"]])))
        show_plot(upset_shared, 11, upset_height(upset_shared))
    }
}
if (has("^clocks_weights\\.tsv$")) {
    clock_cpgs <- read(find("^clocks_weights\\.tsv$"))
    clock_cpgs <- unique(clock_cpgs[, .(clock, cpg, snp = snp %in% TRUE, meqtl = if ("meqtl" %in% names(clock_cpgs)) meqtl %in% TRUE else FALSE)])
    removed_cpgs <- if (has("_filtered_exclusions\\.tsv\\.gz$")) unique(sub("_.*", "", read(find("_filtered_exclusions\\.tsv\\.gz$")[1])[["probe_id"]])) else character()
    if (nrow(tests) > 0) removed_cpgs <- setdiff(removed_cpgs, unique(tests[["cpg"]]))
    flags <- rbind(clock_cpgs[snp == TRUE, .(clock, item = cpg, set = "Common SNP")],
                   clock_cpgs[meqtl == TRUE, .(clock, item = cpg, set = "cis-meQTL")],
                   clock_cpgs[cpg %in% removed_cpgs, .(clock, item = cpg, set = "Removed by the probe filter")],
                   if (nrow(tests) > 0) unique(merge(clock_cpgs[, .(clock, item = cpg)], tests[hit == TRUE, .(item = cpg, set = paste("Hit of model", model))],
                                                     by = "item", allow.cartesian = TRUE))[, .(clock, item, set)])
    if (nrow(flags) > 0) {
        panels[["SNPs, filter and hits"]] <- function() {
            cat(sprintf("%s of the %s clock CpGs carry a common SNP or cis-meQTL, are removed by the probe filter, or are a hit of a model (FDR < 0.05). The clocks are computed after the probe filter, so removed CpGs take the reference mean of the clock.\n\n",
                        big(uniqueN(flags[["item"]])), big(uniqueN(clock_cpgs[["cpg"]]))))
            # a plot only when a CpG has several flags; the table gives the single ones
            if (any(unique(flags[, .(item, set)])[, .N, by = item][["N"]] > 1)) {
                upset <- upset_plot(flags, "Clock CpGs with a SNP, removed by the probe filter or associated", "CpGs", "Every CpG counts once, whichever clocks use it.")
                show_plot(upset, 9, upset_height(upset))
            }
            per_clock <- dcast(unique(flags), clock ~ set, value.var = "item", fun.aggregate = length)
            per_clock <- merge(clock_cpgs[, .(CpGs = uniqueN(cpg)), by = clock], per_clock, by = "clock", all.x = TRUE)
            for (j in names(per_clock)) if (is.integer(per_clock[[j]])) set(per_clock, which(is.na(per_clock[[j]])), j, 0L)
            print(kable(setnames(per_clock[, clock := clock_name(clock)], "clock", "Clock"), caption = "Clock CpGs with each flag"))
        }
    }
}
tabs(panels)
```

```{r meqtl, results = "asis", fig.width = 11, fig.height = 8, eval = has("^meqtl_cpgs_summary\\.tsv$")}
heading("Genetic influence on the clocks")
ms <- read(find("^meqtl_cpgs_summary\\.tsv$"))
mv <- setNames(as.character(ms[["value"]]), ms[["metric"]])
cat(sprintf("The meQTL table gives %s CpGs with a cis-meQTL; %s of them are on this array. Allele frequencies at these CpGs differ between ancestries, and that difference passes into the clock (Meeks et al. 2025).\n\n",
            mv[["cpgs_in_table"]], mv[["cpgs_on_array"]]))
if (has("^clocks_weights\\.tsv$")) {
    w <- read(find("^clocks_weights\\.tsv$"))
    if ("meqtl" %in% names(w) && any(!is.na(w[["meqtl"]]))) {
        w <- w[is.finite(standardised)]
        w[, class := ifelse(meqtl %in% TRUE, "cis-meQTL", ifelse(snp %in% TRUE, "SNP in the probe", "neither"))]
        shares <- w[, .(share = sum(abs(standardised))), by = .(clock, class)][, share := 100 * share / sum(share), by = clock]
        shares[, class := factor(class, levels = c("cis-meQTL", "SNP in the probe", "neither"))]
        show_plot(ggplot(shares, aes(share, clock_name(clock), fill = class)) + geom_col() +
            scale_fill_manual(values = c(`cis-meQTL` = "#c44e52", `SNP in the probe` = "#dd8452", neither = "#bbbbbb")) +
            labs(x = "% of the clock's absolute weight", y = NULL, fill = "CpG class", title = "Clock weight on CpGs under genetic influence"))
    }
}
if (has("^clocks_robust\\.tsv$") && !is.null(clocks)) {
    rob <- read(find("^clocks_robust\\.tsv$"))
    shown <- intersect(grep("^eaa_", names(clocks), value = TRUE), names(rob))
    value_of <- function(table, columns) melt(table[, c("sample", columns), with = FALSE], id.vars = "sample", variable.name = "clock")
    if (length(shown) == 0) shown <- intersect(c("HorvathS2013", "HannumG2013", "LevineM2018", "DunedinPACE"), intersect(names(clocks), names(rob)))
    if (length(shown) > 0) {
        both <- merge(value_of(clocks, shown), value_of(rob, shown), by = c("sample", "clock"), suffixes = c("_full", "_robust"))
        both <- both[is.finite(value_full) & is.finite(value_robust)]
        rho <- both[, .(rho = suppressWarnings(cor(value_full, value_robust, method = "spearman"))), by = clock]
        both <- merge(both, rho, by = "clock")
        both[, panel := sprintf("%s (rho %.2f)", clock_name(sub("^eaa_", "", clock)), rho)]
        show_plot(ggplot(both, aes(value_full, value_robust)) + geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
            geom_point(size = 0.8, alpha = 0.6, colour = "#4c72b0") + facet_wrap(~panel, scales = "free") +
            labs(x = if (startsWith(shown[1], "eaa_")) "Acceleration, full clock" else "Clock value, full clock",
                 y = "Without SNP and cis-meQTL CpGs", title = "Genotype-robust clocks",
                 subtitle = "CpGs with a common SNP or cis-meQTL held at their mean."))
    }
}
if (has("^ewas_summary_meqtl\\.tsv$")) {
    em <- read(find("^ewas_summary_meqtl\\.tsv$"))
    if (nrow(em) > 0) print(kable(em[, .(Model = model, Contrast = contrast, `Hits (FDR < 0.05)` = hits_fdr, `Hits with a cis-meQTL` = hits_meqtl,
                                         `Share of hits` = share_hits, `Share of tested CpGs` = share_tested, `Odds ratio` = odds_ratio, P = p_value)],
                               caption = "Association hits with a cis-meQTL"))
}
```

```{r biomarkers, results = "asis", fig.width = 11, fig.height = 8, eval = has("^biomarkers_agreement\\.tsv$")}
part("Clocks, cells and phenotypes")
stars <- function(q) ifelse(is.na(q), "", ifelse(q < 0.001, "***", ifelse(q < 0.01, "**", ifelse(q < 0.05, "*", ""))))
cat("Clocks enter as age acceleration (residual on the reported age), scores as they are. Stars: q < 0.05, 0.01, 0.001 (Benjamini-Hochberg).\n\n")
agreement <- read(find("^biomarkers_agreement\\.tsv$"))
if (nrow(agreement) > 0) {
    heading("Agreement of the clocks and scores")
    m <- unique(c(agreement[["measure1"]], agreement[["measure2"]]))
    full <- rbind(agreement[, .(a = measure1, b = measure2, rho)], agreement[, .(a = measure2, b = measure1, rho)], data.table(a = m, b = m, rho = 1))
    show_plot(ggplot(full, aes(factor(measure_name(a), levels = measure_name(m)), factor(measure_name(b), levels = rev(measure_name(m))), fill = rho)) + geom_tile(colour = "white") +
        geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", rho)), size = 2.3) + scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#4c72b0", high = "#c44e52", limits = c(-1, 1)) +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1)) + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Spearman rho", title = "Agreement of the clocks and scores (Spearman)"))
}
```

```{r quartiles, results = "asis", fig.width = 14, fig.height = 12, eval = has("^biomarkers_quartiles\\.tsv$")}
qt <- read(find("^biomarkers_quartiles\\.tsv$"))
if (nrow(qt) > 0) {
    heading("Quartile groups of acceleration")
    cat("Low: bottom quarter of the acceleration; mid: middle half; high: top quarter. Numbers: medians, or percentages of a binary trait. Trend: Kendall's tau across the groups.\n\n")
    qt[, group := factor(group, levels = c("decelerated", "normal", "accelerated"), labels = c("low", "mid", "high"))]
    qt[, measure := clock_name(sub(" acceleration$", "", measure))]
    # the stars sit in their own column inside each panel, so they never run into the next panel
    groups <- c("low", "mid", "high", "trend")
    qt[, group := factor(as.character(group), levels = groups)]
    lab <- unique(qt[, .(measure, trait, star = stars(q))])
    lab[, group := factor("trend", levels = groups)]
    n_measures <- uniqueN(qt[["measure"]])
    columns <- min(4, n_measures)
    # many phenotypes are split over several figures, each at most about 30 inches high
    rows <- ceiling(n_measures / columns)
    per_part <- min(24, max(5, floor((30 / rows - 0.8) / 0.26)))
    traits <- unique(qt[["trait"]])
    parts <- split(traits, ceiling(seq_along(traits) / per_part))
    tabs(setNames(lapply(seq_along(parts), function(i) function() {
        part <- qt[trait %in% parts[[i]]]
        show_plot(ggplot(part, aes(group, trait)) + geom_tile(aes(fill = mean_z), colour = "white") + geom_text(aes(label = signif(value, 3)), size = 2.4) +
            geom_text(data = lab[trait %in% parts[[i]]], aes(x = group, y = trait, label = star), colour = "#b2182b", size = 3.4, fontface = "bold") +
            scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) + facet_wrap(~ measure, ncol = columns) +
            scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#4c72b0", high = "#c44e52", limits = c(-0.8, 0.8), oob = scales::squish) +
            theme(panel.spacing.x = unit(1.5, "lines"), panel.spacing.y = unit(1, "lines"), panel.grid = element_blank(),
                  legend.position = "bottom", legend.key.width = unit(2.5, "cm"), legend.title = element_text(vjust = 0.8),
                  legend.margin = margin(t = 10)) +
            labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Mean z of the trait in the group",
                 title = paste0("Characteristics by quartile group of acceleration", if (length(parts) > 1) sprintf(" (part %d of %d)", i, length(parts)))),
            4 * columns, 1.5 + rows * (0.8 + 0.26 * length(parts[[i]])))
    }), paste("Part", seq_along(parts))))
}
```

```{r contamination, results = "asis", fig.width = 11, fig.height = 7, eval = has("^biomarkers_contamination\\.tsv$") && !is.null(qc) && "snp_outlier" %in% names(qc)}
ct <- read(find("^biomarkers_contamination\\.tsv$"))
if (nrow(ct) > 0) {
    heading("Contamination and the ageing measures")
    cutoff <- ct[["cutoff"]][1]
    threshold <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(param("snp_outlier_threshold")))
    bullets(c(sprintf("Arrays above a SNP outlier score of %s fail QC. Of the analysed arrays, %d lie above the robust cutoff of %.2f (median plus three MADs).",
                      param("snp_outlier_threshold"), ct[["arrays_above_cutoff"]][1], cutoff),
              sprintf("%d of %d clocks and scores correlate with the score at q < 0.05.", sum(ct[["q"]] < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), nrow(ct)),
              "The phenotype tests without the arrays above the cutoff are the version 'low contamination' above."))
    print(kable(ct[, .(Measure = measure_name(measure), `Spearman rho` = rho, q = signif(q, 3), Arrays = n)], caption = "SNP outlier score against the clocks and scores"))
    if (!is.null(clocks)) {
        main <- intersect(c("HorvathS2013", "HannumG2013", "LevineM2018", "PCGrimAge", "DunedinPACE"), names(clocks))
        long <- rbindlist(lapply(main, function(k) {
            column <- if (paste0("eaa_", k) %in% names(clocks)) paste0("eaa_", k) else k
            data.table(sample = clocks[["sample"]], panel = if (column == k) clock_name(k) else paste(clock_name(k), "acceleration"), value = as.numeric(clocks[[column]]))
        }))
        long <- merge(long, qc[, .(sample, snp_outlier, status)], by = "sample")[is.finite(value) & is.finite(snp_outlier)]
        if (nrow(long) > 0) {
            rho <- long[, .(label = sprintf("%s (rho %.2f)", panel[1], suppressWarnings(cor(snp_outlier, value, method = "spearman")))), by = panel]
            long <- merge(long, rho, by = "panel")
            show_plot(ggplot(long, aes(snp_outlier, value)) + geom_point(aes(colour = status), size = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
                geom_vline(xintercept = cutoff, linetype = 2, colour = "#dd8452") +
                geom_vline(xintercept = threshold, linetype = 2, colour = "#c44e52") +
                facet_wrap(~label, scales = "free_y") +
                labs(x = "SNP outlier score (higher: more likely contaminated)", y = NULL, colour = "QC status",
                     title = "Contamination against the main clocks", subtitle = "Orange line: robust cutoff; red line: QC threshold."))
        }
    }
}
```

```{r pca, results = "asis", fig.width = 11, fig.height = 10, eval = has("^pca_variance\\.tsv$")}
part("Sources of variation")
heading("Principal components")
variance <- read(find("^pca_variance\\.tsv$"))
panels <- list()
panels[["Variance"]] <- function() show_plot(ggplot(variance, aes(factor(pc, levels = pc), variance_explained, fill = tested)) + geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#4c72b0", `FALSE` = "#bbbbbb")) +
    labs(x = "Principal component", y = "Share of variance", fill = "Tested for\nassociations", title = "Variance explained by the principal components of the most variable CpGs"), 11, 5)
associations <- read(find("^pca_associations\\.tsv$"))
if (nrow(associations) > 0) panels[["What they follow"]] <- function() {
    shares <- setNames(variance[["variance_explained"]], variance[["pc"]])
    pcs <- unique(associations[["pc"]])
    pcs <- pcs[order(as.integer(sub("^PC", "", pcs)))]
    associations[, pc := factor(pc, levels = pcs)]
    if (!"adj_r_squared" %in% names(associations)) associations[, adj_r_squared := r_squared]
    show_plot(ggplot(associations, aes(pc, variable, fill = pmax(adj_r_squared, 0))) + geom_tile(colour = "white") +
        geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(p_value < 0.001, sprintf("%.2f", adj_r_squared), "")), size = 2.6) +
        scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#c44e52", limits = c(0, NA)) +
        scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) sprintf("%s (%.1f%%)", x, 100 * shares[x])) +
        facet_grid(group ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
        theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 9)) +
        labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Adjusted\nR-squared", title = "What the principal components follow",
             subtitle = "Adjusted R-squared of each variable; numbers where P < 0.001. In brackets: share of the variance of the component."),
        12, max(5, 1.6 + 0.24 * uniqueN(associations[["variable"]])))
}
if (has("^pca_scores\\.tsv$")) {
    pc_scores <- read(find("^pca_scores\\.tsv$"))
    if (all(c("PC1", "PC2") %in% names(pc_scores))) panels[["PC1 and PC2"]] <- function() {
        sex_column <- if (is.null(qc)) character() else head(intersect(c("predicted_sex_ewastools", "predicted_sex_minfi", "reported_sex"), names(qc)), 1)
        pc_scores[, group := "all arrays"]
        if (length(sex_column) == 1) {
            pc_scores <- merge(pc_scores, qc[, c("sample", sex_column), with = FALSE], by = "sample", all.x = TRUE)
            pc_scores[, group := ifelse(is.na(get(sex_column)), "unknown", as.character(get(sex_column)))]
        }
        pc_scores[, outlier := FALSE]
        if (has("^pca_outliers\\.tsv$")) pc_scores[, outlier := sample %in% read(find("^pca_outliers\\.tsv$"))[pca_outlier %in% TRUE, sample]]
        axis_label <- function(pc) {
            share <- variance[["variance_explained"]][match(pc, variance[["pc"]])]
            if (is.na(share)) pc else sprintf("%s (%.1f%%)", pc, 100 * share)
        }
        show_plot(ggplot(pc_scores, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = group, shape = outlier)) + geom_point(size = 1.6, alpha = 0.8) +
            scale_shape_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 16, `TRUE` = 4), labels = c(`FALSE` = "no", `TRUE` = "yes")) +
            labs(x = axis_label("PC1"), y = axis_label("PC2"), colour = if (length(sex_column) == 1) "Sex" else NULL, shape = "PCA outlier",
                 title = "Arrays on the first two principal components"), 9, 6)
    }
}
tabs(panels)
if (has("^pca_outliers\\.tsv$")) {
    outliers <- read(find("^pca_outliers\\.tsv$"))
    flagged <- outliers[pca_outlier %in% TRUE]
    cat("\n\nOutliers on PC1 and PC2 (reported, not removed): ", if (nrow(flagged) > 0) paste(flagged[["sample"]], collapse = ", ") else "none",
        ". An outlier has a robust Mahalanobis distance above the chi-square 0.999 quantile.\n\n", sep = "")
}
```
